title: Piracy
text:
66.-(1) A person who does any act of violence, detention or degradation for private ends by the crew or passengers of a private ship or aircraft against another ship or aircraft, persons or property; participates in the operation of a pirate ship or aircraft with knowledge of the facts; or incites or intentionally facilitates such an act, commits an act of piracy.
(2) A person who does or participates in piracy commits an offence of piracy and on conviction is liable to imprisonment for life.
